subject.title: Feature: groupScope option to consolidate group sessions into main

question: Should OpenClaw add a focused `groupScope` main-session option for selected group/channel peers now, or defer this to the broader shared-session routing design?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds config surface and intentionally changes a session/security boundary, which needs maintainer product and security direction.

options.title: Review the focused PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91702 as the candidate while requiring explicit opt-in semantics, security docs, upgrade/default proof, and current-base refresh before merge.

options.title: Use the broader tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/19929 canonical if maintainers want named/shared session groups instead of a focused group-to-main option.

options.title: Reject core group-to-main scope
options.body: Keep group/channel sessions isolated in core and document memory or manual context-sharing alternatives for trusted groups.

recommendation.title: Review the focused PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91702 as the candidate while requiring explicit opt-in semantics, security docs, upgrade/default proof, and current-base refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current routing/session history and prior review context for this cross-cutting product/security routing choice.
